rules.expression:
(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/.git/"
or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")), "/.git")
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/.env."
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/.env/"
or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")), "/.env")
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/.ssh/"
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/.aws/"
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/proc/self/environ"
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "/var/run/secrets/"
or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path, "r")) in {"/id_rsa" "/id_ecdsa" "/id_ed25519" "/keys/service-account.json" "/docker-compose.yml" "/docker-compose.yaml"})

(not cf.bot_management.verified_bot and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not (ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".js") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".css") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".png") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jpg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jpeg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".webp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".avif") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".gif") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".svg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ico") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".woff") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".woff2") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ttf")))
